The '''1994–95 [[Czech First League]]''' was the second season of top-tier [[association football|football]] in the [[Czech Republic]].

==League changes==

'''Relegated to the [[1994–95 Czech 2. Liga]]'''
* [[MFK Vítkovice|Vítkovice]]

'''Relegated to the 1994–95 [[Bohemian Football League]]'''
* [[Dukla Prague]]

'''Promoted from the [[1993–94 Czech 2. Liga]]'''
* [[SK Benešov|Švarc Benešov]]
* [[FK Jablonec|Jablonec]]
